binding: Structured IDs/files/numbers use submission contract; scientific expectations bind the live reference key points. These examples are not hidden required calculation routes.

cases.scenario: An independent physically tracked excitation comparison across all four correct chelate graphs explains the disclosed absorption contrast without common frozen geometries or author bright-state labels.
cases.expected_judgment: Eligible for supported scientific credit if stated evidence exists; no automatic full score.

cases.scenario: Actual spectra/state evidence show that an apparent assignment distinction is unresolved at the modeled resolution; no root is chosen solely to reproduce a wavelength.
cases.expected_judgment: Eligible for full credit for adequately covered question and justified limits, conditional on genuine evidence; uncertainty alone is insufficient.

cases.scenario: Compound 1c strongest 339 nm band is confused with its lower-energy 383 nm feature, or positional-isomer graph labels are interchanged.
cases.expected_judgment: Invalidate affected dependent claims; preserve unrelated valid evidence.

cases.scenario: A converged spectrum for part of the series is retained with limited series coverage; no unsupported four-compound mechanistic ranking is claimed.
cases.expected_judgment: Credit only established coverage and honest diagnosis; no blanket completion.

cases.scenario: Only an old scalar or fluent repetition of the source explanation is supplied for: What molecular explanation of the absorption differences among complexes1a–1d in toluene is supported by the supplied observations and an independent investigation? Establish defensible state/band assignments and the limits of any proposed structure–spectrum relationship.
cases.expected_judgment: No scientific credit for unsupported dependent claims.

cases.scenario: Verify the complete N,O-BF2 graphs and distinct pyridyl/isoquinolyl/quinolyl attachment positions; isomeric1b–1d cannot be identified by formula alone. State labels must correspond to physical transitions rather than being transferred blindly by root index. Deliberately violate one applicable identity/state/reference while leaving the prose coherent.
cases.expected_judgment: Dependent result and scientific-answer credit invalid until corrected.

cases.scenario: A spectral assignment must compare the same kind of observable and show relevant state character/intensity or other sufficient evidence. Explain model-dependent shifts and uncertainty rather than selecting whichever computed root is closest after the fact. Validate the adequacy of structures, methods and analysis for the claims using a defensible route of your choice. Submit the relevant asserted quantity without the evidence needed for that assertion.
cases.expected_judgment: Do not require a prescribed route; withhold unsupported dependent credit.

cases.scenario: Conclusions cover solution absorption of these four molecules. A frontier gap, vertical transition or inferred geometric effect does not establish emission efficiency, crystal polymorphism, white-light generation or OLED performance. Distinguish observed band maxima from computed vertical energies and from a chosen broadening model. Assert the excluded conclusion from a local scalar.
cases.expected_judgment: Reject the overextended claim; retain supported bounded results.

cases.scenario: Failed/absent operations are labeled evidence of scientific equivalence or non-identifiability.
cases.expected_judgment: Reject false completion. Partial/diagnostic records remain admissible.

cases.scenario: Alter a reported raw value, hash, model mapping or source observation while retaining a plausible report.
cases.expected_judgment: Affected evidence fails integrity/extraction checks; apply fabrication policy when established.
